source.reference: Password reset token not invalidated after use: CVE-2026-28268 (vikunja), GHSA-gcqq-fxw6-f866 (openeclass), CVE-2024-5277 (lunary)
source.upstream_licence: AGPL-3.0 (vikunja) / GPL-3.0 (openeclass) — copyleft, so the pattern is reconstructed and no upstream code is present

defect: resetPassword sets the new password but never calls consumeResetToken, so a reset link works forever.
why_it_is_hard: Nothing in the diff is wrong; a required line is absent. The feature works, all three shipped tests pass, and the function that should have been called lives in tokens.ts, which the diff does not touch — the reviewer only sees the omission if it selects a file outside the change.
notes: The upstream advisories describe exactly this shape: the reset succeeds and the token record is left behind.
